LanguageData.CF_StyleTip: Colony focus. Shifts the importance of selected jobs up or down.
LanguageData.CF_HeaderHint: Steward: middle-click locks or unlocks the whole job.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Balanced: The style for everything. Work is spread evenly over the colonists and follows what is waiting on the map: every job with work to do (bills, building, harvest, hauling, patients, research, animals …) gets at least one colonist, more when there is a lot. Reacts to shortages and crises. Switch to another style only when you need something done first.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Survival: Food and shelter first: cooking, fields, hunting, fishing and a little building. For a hard start.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Production: Workshop, smithy and tailoring, all equally important.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Research: As much research as possible (and entity study with Anomaly).
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Farming: Fields first: sowing and harvesting, with plant cutting and cooking.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Building: Building first, mining stone and hauling help.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Industry: Mining ore and turning it into goods at the smithy and workshop.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Defense: Walls and turrets, weapons from the smithy and doctors ready for raids.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Care: Doctors, children, prisoners and clean rooms.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Comfort: A clean and beautiful base: cleaning, art and furniture.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Trade: Goods to sell: art, clothes and crafted items.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Ranching: Animals first: taming, training, milking, shearing – and their feed.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Custom: Your own style – nothing changes by itself. Importance, number of colonists and colonists per priority level come only from the mod settings (Options → Mod settings → Steward, tabs Work types and Priority levels). Crises and situations still apply (they can be switched off in the settings). No demand, no inspiration or apprentice changes, no reshuffling; re-planned only when colonists come or go, on the regular check or when you press the button.
LanguageData.CF_PA_Desc: Drag a rectangle over the place to work on. Then choose what to do (default everything: building, deconstruction, repairs, mining, cutting, harvesting, hauling, cleaning), now or after the current work, and who does it (nearest automatically or picked by hand). Eating, sleeping and doctoring still come first. The area stays until everything inside is done; remove it with "Remove priority area".
LanguageData.CF_PA_ClearDesc: Drag over a priority area to remove it. Colonists go back to their usual work.
LanguageData.CF_PA_Added: Priority area ({0}): {1} colonists, {2} jobs waiting. The area stays until everything is done.
LanguageData.CF_PA_Stale: Priority area ({0}) ended – nobody did anything inside for two days (the work is out of reach or keeps coming back). Colonists go back to their usual work.
LanguageData.CF_PA_Done: Priority area ({0}) is done, colonists go back to their usual work.
LanguageData.CF_PA_AddedEmpty: Priority area ({0}) created, nothing waits there yet. Designate work (building, mining, cutting…) – {1} colonists do it as soon as it appears.
LanguageData.CF_PA_DlgWork: Waiting there now – building: {0}, mining: {1}, plants: {2}, hauling: {3}, cleaning: {4}
LanguageData.CF_PA_DlgNow: Now – interrupt what they are doing
LanguageData.CF_PA_DlgLater: Later – after they finish what they are doing
LanguageData.CF_HistTip: What the steward changed when and why.
LanguageData.CF_NextRun: Next automatic plan in: {0} (sooner when the work, colonists or a crisis change)
LanguageData.CF_AutoOff: Automatic planning is off – turn on “Steward”.
LanguageData.CF_PA_OnlyBalanced: Areas work in every colony style. They only wait during real danger (enemies, fire, toxic gas at your people …). When a colonist can do nothing in its own area, it helps in another area that is working.
LanguageData.CF_BP_Desc: Colonists do bills at this bench before the other benches of the same work type (crafting, smithing, tailoring, cooking…). Works among benches of the same work type; the order of work types is still set in the Work tab.
LanguageData.CF_BP_NotUsed: Nobody has used it as a priority bench since the game started.
LanguageData.CF_BP_LastUse: Last used as priority bench: {0}, {1} h ago.
LanguageData.CF_TipChildLearn: Child is learning ({0} %) – no work for now.
LanguageData.CF_TipChildLight: Child – work only on the lowest level so it has time to learn (learning {0} %).
LanguageData.CF_StyleStrictNoteOff: Other work: off (hauling and cleaning on the lowest priority).
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_FieldsForest: Only fields and forest: growing and cutting trees, both equally important.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Mining: Only mining ore and stone, hauling helps.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Kitchen: Cooking first, hunting and fishing only bring the ingredients.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_HuntFish: Food from the wild: hunting, fishing and the kitchen to process it.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Smithing: Weapons and tools from the smithy, a little crafting.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Art: Only sculptures and works of art.
LanguageData.CF_StyleDesc_Prison: Prisoners: recruiting and enslaving, with a doctor.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: The Simple mode sets everything by itself, so the details are locked. Want to change them? Switch to Recommended or Advanced at the top.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.CF_TipMother: Mother of a baby – childcare comes first.
LanguageData.CF_TipNanny: Nanny – looks after a baby without a mother who can.
LanguageData.CF_GuardFixed: Mods with work types changed – Steward put the priorities back on the right work for {0} colonists.
LanguageData.CF2_AutoTip: The steward on this map: priorities from skills, passions and the work that really waits on the map. He plans calmly – nobody is moved back and forth.
LanguageData.CF2_PlanNowTip: Plan the priorities right now (even with the steward off). Your plan is not held back by the calm time.
LanguageData.CF2_PlanDone: The steward planned the priorities: {0} changes.
LanguageData.CF2_ManualOn: The steward switched on numbered priorities (Work tab).
LanguageData.CF2_AutoByDefaultTip: When off, you switch the steward on for each map in the Work tab.
LanguageData.CF2_IntervalTip: In between the steward plans only when something really changes (new colonists, much new work, a crisis from an add-on).
LanguageData.CF2_Hold: A changed priority stays at least: {0} h
LanguageData.CF2_HoldTip: Calm: what the steward changed is not changed back at once. Crises and your Plan now button skip it.
LanguageData.CF2_OneTopTip: Each colonist has only his most important work on 1, his other main work on 2.
LanguageData.CF2_Backup: Backup work on the lowest priority
LanguageData.CF2_BackupTip: Who does not have a work as main work keeps it on the lowest level, so nobody stands idle.
LanguageData.CF2_Opposed: Also give work the ideology rejects
LanguageData.CF2_OpposedTip: Off: work the colonist's ideology finds dangerous is never given to him.
LanguageData.CF2_Injured: Hurt and sick colonists get lighter work
LanguageData.CF2_InjuredTip: The worse the health, the less a colonist suits a main work.
LanguageData.CF2_PassionTip: Colonists with a passion get their work more often (they enjoy it and learn faster).
LanguageData.CF2_PreferTip: Middle-click a colonist's name → mark the work he likes. That much is added.
LanguageData.CF2_LodgersTip: Guests from quests who may work.
LanguageData.CF2_MechsTip: Work that mechanoids do needs fewer colonists.
LanguageData.CF2_StyleStrengthTip: How many people a colony style adds to its work.
LanguageData.CF2_StyleStrict: A style plans mainly its own work
LanguageData.CF2_StyleStrictTip: Other work gets only one person when it waits on the map.
LanguageData.CF2_StyleOthersOffTip: Who does not do the style's work does not keep the rest even as backup.
LanguageData.CF2_ChildLearningTip: Children have work only on the lowest level, and none while they need learning.
LanguageData.CF2_ParentCareTip: The mother (or father) has childcare on 1; without a parent the steward picks a nanny.
LanguageData.CF2_LevelsTip: 0 = read from Work Tab / PriorityMaster. Without such a mod the game has 4 levels.
LanguageData.CF2_PlanMessagesTip: A short message top left with the number of changed priorities.
LanguageData.CF2_UseMyRulesTip: Minimum and maximum colonists per work. Crises and situations from add-ons go before the maximum.
LanguageData.CF2_RulesHint: Minimum: at least that many colonists have the work on priority 1–2. Maximum: not more. Importance: how much the work suits as main work (priority 1).
LanguageData.CF2_TipMain: Main work: {0} jobs wait, among the best suited.
LanguageData.CF2_TipStyleReady: Work of the {0} style – ready even when nothing waits now.
LanguageData.CF2_TipHelper: Helper: when the main people cannot keep up.
LanguageData.CF2_TipOnCall: On call: nothing waits now, but someone is ready.
LanguageData.CF2_TipStyleOff: Style {0}: does not do this work.
LanguageData.CF2_TipBackup: Backup: lowest level, so nobody stands idle.
LanguageData.CF2_TipTop: Priority 1: the most important work for him now.
LanguageData.CF2_TipNobodyIdle: Not to stand idle: his best suited work that waits.
LanguageData.CF31_PlanPreview: Show the plan before applying it
LanguageData.CF31_PlanPreviewTip: “Plan now” first shows every change it would make; nothing changes until you press Apply. Automatic plans are not affected.
LanguageData.CF31_PreviewHint: Nothing is changed until you press Apply. The reason is on the right (hover for the full text).
LanguageData.CF31_PreviewNone: Nothing to change – the priorities already match the plan.
LanguageData.CF31_LocksTip: Colonists, work columns and cells the steward must not change. Click to see and unlock them.
LanguageData.CF31_LocksHowTo: Locked things keep their priorities – the steward does not touch them. In the Work tab, the middle mouse button (wheel) locks or unlocks: on a colonist's name the whole colonist, on a column header the work for everybody, on a cell just that cell.
LanguageData.CF31_LocksPawns: Locked colonists (all their work stays as it is)
LanguageData.CF31_StAutoOff: The steward is off on this map – priorities change only with “Plan now”.
LanguageData.CF31_StLockedPawn: Steward: LOCKED – all his work stays as it is. Middle-click the name to unlock.
LanguageData.CF31_StAchtung: Steward: skipped – he has forced work from Achtung!. His priorities stay until the forced work is cleared.
LanguageData.CF31_StDowned: Steward: skipped while he is down – planned again when he is up.
LanguageData.CF31_StSlave: Steward: skipped – slaves are not planned.
LanguageData.CF31_StGuest: Steward: skipped – guest or quest lodger (see “Also plan quest guests” in the settings).
LanguageData.CF31_StNoWork: Steward: skipped – does no work at all.
LanguageData.CF31_StNotHere: Steward: not on this map now – planned on the map where he is.
LanguageData.CF32_ApprenticesTip: A colonist with a passion and little skill gets the work on a learning level (3) when somebody good at it does it as main work. One apprenticeship per colonist, one apprentice per work.
LanguageData.CF32_TipApprentice: Apprentice: has a passion for it and learns next to a master.
LanguageData.CF32_SetsTip: Saved priority sets: save the current priorities under a name (“Winter”, “Defence”, “Harvest” …) and load them again later. Loading shows the changes first.
LanguageData.CF32_SetsHint: Saves the priorities of every colonist on this map. Loading shows all changes first; locked cells and colonists who are not here are skipped. With the steward on, his next plan changes things again – turn him off to keep a set.
LanguageData.CF32_SetsMissing: ({0} colonists from the set are not here)
LanguageData.CF32_OfferNew: Offer work for a new colonist
LanguageData.CF32_OfferNewTip: When the steward is off and a new colonist joins, a window shows the work the steward would give him. Nothing changes unless you press Apply.
LanguageData.CF32_HistNew: Work for the new colonist {0} applied.
LanguageData.CF32_WeeklyTip: Once a week a short message (also in the history): plans and changes, new colonists, work that waited without anybody, crises.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_Desc: A stockpile nobody takes things from. In its storage tab pick what colonists should bring here (it starts empty). While the zone is locked, colonists do not take anything out of it – not to eat, craft, build or equip, and they do not haul it elsewhere. Unlock it with the button on the zone when you need something.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_LockDesc: On: nobody takes or hauls anything out of this zone. Off: it works like a normal stockpile.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_InspectLocked: Locked: colonists only bring things here, nothing is taken out.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_InspectOpen: Unlocked: works like a normal stockpile.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_BeaconDesc: Makes a keep zone over the whole trade area of this beacon. Pick in its storage tab what should go there – colonists bring it and then leave it alone, but traders still see it and can buy it. Things the zone is not set to keep (for example goods you bought) are hauled away as usual.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_WhatDesc: Pick what colonists should bring to this zone and how much of each. Without a list the zone uses its storage tab.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_WinHint: Click a thing on the left to add it. Set an amount – empty means everything there is. Only the listed things are brought here and kept.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_NoneYet: Nothing yet – pick things on the left.
LanguageData.CF_Keep_RowTip: Colonists bring this thing until the zone holds the amount (a hauler carries only what is missing). What lies here stays here.
